items.quote: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
items.claim: Numbers 3:38 says that Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons are to camp on the east side of the tabernacle and keep charge of the sanctuary for the Israelites. Any outsider who comes near is to be put to death.
items.actor: Moses, and Aaron and his sons
items.action: encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, keeping the charge of the sanctuary
items.object: the sanctuary / tabernacle of the congregation
items.mechanism: a priestly guard camped at the entrance keeps outsiders away from the sanctuary, and the penalty for coming near is death
